abstract: OBJECTIVES: To determine the frequency, characteristics, treatment and outcome of patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumor (MOGCT) in King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital during the period January 1992 - December 2000. STUDY DESIGN: Retrospective descriptive study MATERIAL AND METHOD: All patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumor in King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital during the period January 1992 - December 2000 were analyzed by the characteristics of patients, treatment and outcome. RESULTS: Sixty-six patients with MOGCT were demonstrated in that period with a mean age of 22.6 years old. Most of the patients were nulliparous and premenopausal status. Primary surgery was done in all patients. Forty-two patients (63.6%) received conservative surgery. Eight patients received no adjuvant treatment after surgery due to stage 1A dysgerminoma and immature teratoma stage I grade I. Fifty-six patients received chemotherapy for adjuvant treatment. VAC regimen was given in 27 cases (40.9%) and PVB regimen was given in 25 cases (37.9%). Salvage therapy in the patients with persistent and recurrent disease was treated in 9 patients, who received a platinum-base of regimen. Two-year survival was 88% with the median time to follow up 24 months. Overall five-year survival in the present study was 85%. CONCLUSION: MOGCT in King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital had clinical characteristics similar to other studies in malignant ovarian germ cell tumor Treatment by VAC regimen still has benefit in selected group.
abstract_ja: 目的：キング・チュラロンコーン記念病院における悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(MOGCT)患者の頻度、特徴、治療および転帰を明らかにする。研究デザイン：後方視的記述研究。対象と方法：1992年1月〜2000年12月に同院で悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と診断された全患者を、患者特性、治療、転帰の観点から解析した。結果：この期間に66例のMOGCT患者が認められ、平均年齢は22.6歳であった。大半の患者は未経産で閉経前であった。全例で初回手術が行われた。42例(63.6%)が温存手術を受けた。術後補助療法を受けなかった8例は、病期IAのディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）および病期I・Grade Iの未熟奇形腫の症例であった。56例が術後補助化学療法を受けた。VAC療法が27例(40.9%)、PVB療法が25例(37.9%)に施行された。持続性・再発性疾患の患者9例に対しては白金製剤を含むレジメンによる救済療法が行われた。2年生存率は88%、中央値の追跡期間は24ヶ月であった。本研究における5年生存率は85%であった。結論：当院のMOGCTは、他の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の報告と類似した臨床的特徴を有していた。VAC療法は一部の選択された症例で依然として有益である。
